title: docs(permissions): name the seam in the two census `row N` sentences that were declared unheld
body:
Fixes #15927

`scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs` holds each `row N` reference on
`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` to its table row **by seam**, and refuses when the
numbering moves under it. Two of the references were declared `unheld`, and an `unheld` entry is
LOCATED without ever having its **number compared** — so an insertion above the row still moved
what the sentence pointed at and nothing refused. The card's own words: *a falsified reference is
worse than a dangling one, because it resolves*.

The remedy is prose, not gate code. Both sentences are reworded so each **names the seam it is
about**, after which the existing `PAGE_ROW_REFERENCES` mechanism holds them with no new
machinery. No new gate code is added.

## What changed

| where | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| row 1's `Lose:` cell | stated the RANGE `rows 2-7`, whose endpoints the sentence never named and which is not a section extent | names the LAST behaviour the short-circuit swallows — the write-bypass row that widens the effective write scope to `org` — and carries one reference to it |
| the Sharing Rules bullet under `## Related` | rested only on the linked doc title, and several rows are about sharing rules | names the hook the skip is on: the record-`afterDelete` revocation skip, which exactly one row is |

The two `PAGE_ROW_REFERENCES` entries convert from `unheld` to `seam`, and the self-test's
real-page assertion moves from 10 page + 8 `why:` + 2 unheld to 12 page + 8 `why:` + 0 unheld.

⛔ Deliberately **not** claimed, carried through from the card unchanged:

- ⛔ no claim that #15869 should have stayed open — its landing measurement is sound;
- ⛔ no claim these two sentences were *wrong* on the tree. They were correct; they were simply
  **unguarded against the next renumbering**. This PR changes nothing a reader is told today.

## Acceptance — both directions driven

**GREEN** — `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`, exit 0:

```
before  18 row reference(s) resolve to their keyed row, 2 declared unheld.
after   20 row reference(s) resolve to their keyed row, 0 declared unheld.
```

The total does **not** drop: 18 + 2 = 20 stays 20. `pnpm check:system-context-census`
(self-test + real run) is green.

**RED** — a renumbering ablation, run on the REAL tracked page on disk with the REAL gate. A row
was inserted above row 7 and the table renumbered, so both named seams move. The gate exits 1 and
names both rewritten sentences:

```
GATE EXIT = 1   (8 [row-ref-falsified] refusals in all)
[row-ref-falsified] content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx:98 says `row 7`, but the seam that
  sentence is about (`Write bypass = `true`, effective write scope = `org``) is row 8 ...
[row-ref-falsified] content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx:472 says `row 31`, but the seam that
  sentence is about (`on the record-`afterDelete` hook`) is row 32 ...
```

On-disk mutation proof, before reading any verdict: the inserted marker went from 0 to 1
occurrences, `| 7 | Write bypass` from 1 to 0, and `| 8 | Write bypass` from 0 to 1.

**COUNTER-LEG** — the same insertion against the PRE-fix page and the PRE-fix ledger (the
mechanism `checkRowReferences` is byte-identical in this diff, so the sentences and their two
entries are the only variables): **0** refusals name either sentence, in both the
insert-above-7 and the insert-above-31 variants, while the other references red normally. That is
the defect, reproduced.

**Independence** — inserting above row 31 alone reds the Sharing Rules bullet and leaves the row-1
sentence untouched, so the row-1 sentence is keyed to row 7 specifically and not to "any
renumbering".

**RESTORE** — byte-identical. HEAD blob `57a87493f921eeee56f19d7ff04fb55874c783c8`, working-tree
hash after restore `57a87493f921eeee56f19d7ff04fb55874c783c8`, `git diff HEAD` empty and
`git status --porcelain` clean. The ablation script carried a `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` restoring
by absolute path against `HEAD`.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at
this commit — **62 families, all 62 run, all exit 0**, reconciled with `--ran` carrying every exit
code (`62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` — a DERIVED zero).

- `pnpm check:system-context-census` — exit 0, the reading above.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` — exit 0, detached and waited on. ⚠ **711.6s on this box**, not
  the 430–450s carried in the dispatch — worth re-recording.
- Five families first returned `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (`exit 3`, and one `exit 1` of the same
  kind) because workspace packages were unbuilt — not findings, and not measurements. After
  `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/spec...' build` and
  `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' --filter '@objectstack/client...' build` all five
  are exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, the repo-wide union, CI's own run) — exit 0 at
  `c5c859cf4`, the final commit. No narrowing was taken, so none is declared.

## Changeset

**`skip-changeset`** — nothing already published moves, measured rather than assumed. Of 70
published workspace packages, **zero** declare a `files[]` entry reaching repo-root `content/` or
`scripts/` or escaping their own package root; both changed paths sit outside every package
directory, and the only `package.json` above them is the private monorepo root
(`@objectstack/spec-monorepo`, `private: true`). Positive control: `@objectstack/spec` really does
declare shipped paths (`dist`, `json-schema`, `api-surface`, …), so the reader is looking at real
data. The label is applied on this PR.

## Not done here

The `--fix` leg that renumbers prose remains unbuilt — the gate is refuse-only for prose by its
own docblock's design, and building it would be new gate code the card forbids. With `0 declared
unheld` the refuse-only behaviour now covers all 20 references rather than 18 of them.
